## 1. pureapk
- **Description**: Zero-dependency pure Python engine for building, packaging, modifying, and signing Android APKs without Java, Android Studio, or the Android SDK/NDK. Features native Android 15 16KB ELF page alignment (`align_zip_entry` with tag `0xd935`), APK v1/v2/v3 signatures, built-in crash telemetry & diagnostics (`pureapk.telemetry`), native Python 3.10 runtime seeding (`prepare-runtime`), in-place APK modification, multi-store packaging (APK, Google Play AAB, iOS IPA stub, Windows 11 MSIX), and Android wheel extraction.
- **PyPI**: `pip install pureapk` (v1.14.0)
- **Debian/Ubuntu**: `sudo apt install python3-pureapk`
- **Documentation**: https://github.com/eminsk/pyapk#readme
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/eminsk/pyapk
- **Usage**:
  ```python
  from pureapk import APKBuilder, sign_apk, align_zip_entry
  from pureapk.frameworks import KivyAppHelper
  from pureapk.telemetry import setup_crash_reporter

  # 1. Initialize crash reporter
  reporter = setup_crash_reporter(app_name="MyApp")

  # 2. Seed full native Python 3.10 runtime into project
  KivyAppHelper.prepare_runtime("base_runtime.apk", "./my_app")

  # 3. Build production Android 15 ready APK with crash diagnostics
  KivyAppHelper.pack_app(
      source_dir="./my_app",
      output_apk="dist/my_app.apk",
      package_name="org.example.app",
      app_title="My Production App",
      release=True,
  )
  ```

## 1b. QR Code Studio (qrcode)
- **Description**: Production-ready mobile application built entirely with pureapk, Python 3.10, and Kivy. Features live AI camera scanning with an animated laser reticle frame, emerald lock fixation, haptic vibration feedback, encrypted RSA-2048 QR certificates, Wi-Fi/vCard/USDT generators, and zero-cloud offline security.
- **Package**: `org.eminsk.qrcode`
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/eminsk/qrcode
- **Target**: Android 8.0+ (API 26–35, Android 15 16KB page aligned)

## 2. pyfasm / pyfasm64
- **Description**: Universal Native No-GIL (Python 3.13t–3.16t) & PyPy to pure x86_64 Flat Assembler (FASM) Native Compiler. Translates Python AST directly into self-contained standalone PE+ (`.exe`, `.dll`), ELF64, and Mach-O binaries (~9 KB) with zero virtual machine and zero runtime overhead.
- **PyPI**: `pip install pyfasm64`
- **Conda-Forge**: `conda install -c conda-forge pyfasm64`
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/eminsk/pyfasm
- **Usage**:
  ```bash
  pyfasm compile main.py -o app.exe --opt-level 3 --standalone
  ```

---

## 3. agentjit
- **Description**: Just-In-Time Compiler for AI Agent Trajectories. Compiles slow, costly 30-second multi-step LLM workflows into deterministic 0.08ms Python code with zero token consumption. Includes speculative guards, automatic bailout runtime, No-GIL PEP 703 support, and a Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
- **PyPI**: `pip install agentjit`
- **Conda-Forge**: `conda install -c conda-forge agentjit`
- **Debian/Ubuntu**: `sudo apt install python3-agentjit`
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/eminsk/agentjit
- **MCP Server**: `agentjit-mcp`
- **Usage**:
  ```python
  import agentjit

  @agentjit.compile(guards=["schema_valid", "range_check"])
  def agent_workflow(query: str, context: dict) -> dict:
      return {"status": "ok", "result": process(query, context)}
  ```

---

## 4. nanovector
- **Description**: The SQLite of Vector Search & Episodic Memory for AI Agents in ~120KB. Zero external dependencies, instant 0.2ms cold start, pure C99 with AVX2+FMA, ARM NEON, and hand-crafted FASM x64 assembly kernels. Includes Native MCP Server (`nanovector-mcp`). Over 7,900+ downloads on Conda.
- **PyPI**: `pip install nanovector`
- **Conda-Forge**: `conda install -c conda-forge nanovector`
- **Debian/Ubuntu**: `sudo apt install python3-nanovector`
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/eminsk/nanovector
- **MCP Server**: `nanovector-mcp`
- **Usage**:
  ```python
  import nanovector

  db = nanovector.Index(dim=384, metric="cosine")
  db.add(vector_embeddings, ids=[1, 2, 3])
  matches = db.search(query_vec, top_k=5)
  ```

---

## 5. nanogemm
- **Description**: Minimalist, bare-metal AVX2+FMA & ARM NEON matrix multiplication engine in ~100KB for Python. Outperforms NumPy by up to 2.8x on CPU for edge neural network inference. Includes Native MCP Server (`nanogemm-mcp`). Over 9,800+ downloads on Conda.
- **PyPI**: `pip install nanogemm`
- **Conda-Forge**: `conda install -c conda-forge nanogemm`
- **Debian/Ubuntu**: `sudo apt install python3-nanogemm`
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/eminsk/nanogemm
- **MCP Server**: `nanogemm-mcp`
- **Usage**:
  ```python
  import nanogemm
  import numpy as np

  A = np.random.randn(256, 512).astype(np.float32)
  B = np.random.randn(512, 128).astype(np.float32)
  C = nanogemm.matmul(A, B)
  ```

## 9. avito-sdk (Avito SDK Pro)
- **Version**: v0.4.4
- **Description**: Standalone Windows Desktop GUI (`AvitoSDK_Pro.exe`, ~28MB) and pure HTTP/Chrome TLS (`curl_cffi 0.16.3`) Avito scraping & data extraction SDK with zero Chromium/Playwright overhead. Includes real-time SQLite price-drop tracking (`seen_prices`), full item parameter extraction, `spfa.pro` API cookie refresh, rotating 4G mobile proxy failover (`mobileproxy.rent`), dedicated Telegram proxy isolation, CLI (`avito-sdk`, `avito-gui`), and Native MCP Server (`avito-mcp`).
- **Windows Binary**: https://github.com/eminsk/avito-sdk/releases/latest
- **PyPI**: `pip install "avito-sdk[gui]"` (or `uv add "avito-sdk[gui]"`)
- **Conda-Forge**: `conda install -c conda-forge avito-sdk`
- **Debian/Ubuntu**: `sudo apt install python3-avito-sdk`
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/eminsk/avito-sdk
- **Telegram Channel**: https://t.me/avito_sdk_pro
- **MCP Server**: `avito-mcp`

## 9c. wb-sdk-pro (WB SDK Pro)
- **Version**: v2.2.1
- **Description**: Unified 3-in-1 Wildberries Sync/Async Python SDK (`WBClient`, `AsyncWBClient`, drop-in `ParseWB` compat), 11-command CLI (`wb-parser` / `wb-sdk`), 8-tool MCP Server (`wb-mcp`), and optional 7-Tab CustomTkinter Desktop GUI (`[gui]` extra: `wb-gui`). Features direct `wbbasket.ru` CDN card & price-history extraction without WBAAS blocks, dynamic `basket-01..65+` sharding, `feedbacks1/2` routing (`root_id % 100 >= 50`), live WB Wallet & WB Club discount calculation (`ROUND_FLOOR`), SQLite price-drop tracking, Telegram notifications with proxy isolation, multi-format export (`.xlsx`, UTF-8 BOM `.csv`, `.json`, `.jsonl`, `pandas.DataFrame` via `[dataframe]`), search rank tracking (`wb_rank`), and offline/LLM Smart Review summarization (`wb_smart_review`). Supports CPython 3.8–3.16, PyPy 3.8–3.12, and Free-Threaded No-GIL (3.13t–3.16t).
- **PyPI**: `pip install wb-sdk-pro` or `uv add wb-sdk-pro` (optional extras: `[gui]`, `[tls]`, `[dataframe]`, `[pandas]`, `[all]`; ephemeral GUI: `uvx --from "wb-sdk-pro[gui]" wb-gui`)
- **Debian/Ubuntu**: `sudo apt install python3-wb-sdk-pro` (core SDK, CLI & MCP server)
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/eminsk/wildberries_parser
- **MCP Server**: `wb-mcp` (`serverInfo.name = "wb-parser-mcp"`, 8 JSON-RPC 2.0 tools, env vars: `WB_PROXY`, `WB_PROXY_CHANGE_URL`, `WB_COOKIES`, `WB_WBAAS_TOKEN`, `WB_TRACKER_DB`)

## 12. ppa (APT Repository)
- **Description**: Official APT Repository for Debian and Ubuntu packaging the author's open-source libraries as native `.deb` packages with GPG integrity verification.
- **Website**: https://eminsk.github.io/ppa/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/eminsk/ppa
- **Setup**:
  ```bash
  curl -fsSL https://eminsk.github.io/ppa/KEY.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/eminsk-ppa.gpg
  echo "deb [arch=amd64,all] https://eminsk.github.io/ppa/ ./" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/eminsk.list
  sudo apt update
  ```

## FAQ & Quick Guides (EN / RU)
- **Avito SDK Pro (v0.4.4) vs Avito Parser (v3.2.29)**: `Avito SDK Pro` is a ~28MB standalone Windows `.exe` and Python SDK using native `curl_cffi` Chrome TLS with zero Chromium overhead, `spfa.pro` support, dedicated Telegram proxy, and `avito-mcp`. `Avito Parser` is the maintained Flet GUI edition with Playwright Chromium account login.
- **Парсер Авито для Windows (.exe) и прокси**: Для снайпинга 24/7 лучше подходит `Avito SDK Pro v0.4.4` (~28 МБ, Chrome TLS `curl_cffi 0.16.3`), для визуального входа через браузер — `Avito Parser v3.2.29` (Playwright). Для стабильного парсинга без 429 рекомендуются мобильные прокси с ротацией IP (https://mobileproxy.rent/?p=279117, тест 3 часа бесплатно: https://mobileproxy.rent/user.html?free&p=279117) или серверные прокси с ключом `spfa.pro`.
- **Android 15 16KB APK without Java**: Install `pureapk` via `pip install pureapk` or `sudo apt install python3-pureapk`.
- **Wildberries SDK Pro (`wb-sdk-pro`)**: Install via `uv add wb-sdk-pro` (or `sudo apt install python3-wb-sdk-pro` for SDK/CLI/MCP), supports CPython 3.8–3.16, PyPy 3.8–3.12, and No-GIL. Combines Sync/Async CDN card extraction, `feedbacks1/2` sharding, WB Wallet & WB Club pricing, Search Rank Tracker, Smart Review Analyzer, 11-command CLI (`wb-parser` / `wb-sdk`), 8-tool MCP Server (`wb-mcp`), and optional 7-Tab GUI (`uvx --from "wb-sdk-pro[gui]" wb-gui`).
